params.body:
In the Netwerk panel, the tabs Overdracht / Werkt samen met (relation) and Overdracht / Relaties (project) were a thin underline: easy to miss that there is a second tab at all.

They are now a switch: two equal halves on a grey bar, the open one white with a border and a light shadow. Each has the icon the menu uses: Te doen's for Overdracht, Netwerk's for Werkt samen met and Relaties. Same behaviour and count as before.

Checked by screenshot on the demo DB, desktop and phone width (it fits on one line at 390px). View only; full suite 362/362.
params.title: Netwerk: make the panel's two tabs a visible switch, with icons
